summary: Företag 18 is a biotechnology company developing in vivo cell reprogramming technologies for cancer immunotherapy. Its lead program, AT-108, is an off-the-shelf gene therapy designed to trigger anti-tumor immune responses.
target_market: Global oncology and cancer immunotherapy market
strategy_notes: Focused on advancing AT-108 toward clinical development and establishing partnerships with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies for future commercialization.
technology_notes: Uses direct cell reprogramming and gene therapy approaches to convert tumor cells into antigen-presenting cells capable of stimulating anti-cancer immune responses.
risk_notes: Subject to clinical development, regulatory approval, financing, partnership and technology validation risks common to early-stage biotechnology companies.
